title: DVB-T2 BICM application on gf2-sim
description:
## Goal

Use the new `gf2-sim` pipeline to express the DVB-T2 BICM AWGN
chain via the typestate-builder preset, migrate the existing
campaign binary to the new pipeline, and provide the CPU-vs-GPU
byte-identity regression for the DVB-T2 chain. This story
unblocks the multi-day production sweep tracked by
`e4849f07` (which stays in `epic:dvb-t2-awgn-campaign`).

## Context

Story under epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Sequencing-blocked on
the hybrid executor story. The DVB-T2 campaign artefacts and
closure note are owned by the existing
`epic:dvb-t2-awgn-campaign`; this story delivers only the
pipeline-side work.

## Deliverables (themes)

- DVB-T2 preset using the typestate builder; graph-API example
  for reference.
- Migrate `crates/gf2-coding/src/bin/dvb_t2_awgn_campaign.rs`
  from `SimulationRunner::run_with_decoder` to the new pipeline,
  preserving `--decoder`, `--demap`, and the `--gpu`
  CLI-surface reservation.
- CPU-vs-GPU byte-identity regression for the DVB-T2 chain on
  the four deterministic columns at a fixed seed.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] All child tasks complete with required gates green.
- [hard] Byte-identity regression passes for the DVB-T2 chain
  across {CPU-only, CPU-parallel, CPU+GPU} executions at the
  same seed.
- [hard] Campaign binary, when invoked at the existing
  `dev/benchmarks/dvb_t2_awgn/PLAN.md` brackets, reaches the
  ≥ 100 frame-error criterion at each bracket point in
  ≤ 24h wall-clock per (rate, modulation) configuration.
- [hard] `e4849f07` (in `epic:dvb-t2-awgn-campaign`) is
  unblocked by the binary wire-up task in this story (cross-epic
  dep).

## Non-goals

- The closure note and PNG overlays remain part of `e4849f07`'s
  scope, not this story.
- 5G NR work — handled by the next story.
